description: A sleek, upscale private gym or fitness center with a long corridor-like plan viewed in one-point perspective receding toward the back. The ceiling is clad in warm dark walnut-toned wood planks with thin recessed linear LED strips running the full length, casting flat white light down either side of the ceiling plane. The floor transitions between black rubber fitness flooring on the left equipment side and light natural oak herringbone parquet on the treadmill side. A row of commercial black treadmills lines the right wall, each facing floor-to-ceiling framed windows with views to a green tree canopy outside. A living green moss wall fills the back wall behind the treadmill row. On the left side, dark walnut vertical slat wall panels back a mirror wall, beyond which a cable weight rack and weight bench with black rubber bumper plates are arranged. The overall palette is dark, moody, and masculine — dark walnut, matte black, charcoal, punctuated by the warmth of the wood floor. Warm light traces streak down the length of the space from the ceiling zone. Camera is at standing or slightly elevated eye-level, perfectly centered, one-point perspective shooting straight down the long axis of the gym toward the back moss wall. A lighting fixture matching the product reference image is installed naturally within this scene at the appropriate location for the product category.
